answer: A one-way admission toll gates the umber: each new agent posts a refundable 120-credit bond before its first vine is counted; five established peers must co-sign the same vine within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each anchor-style fake costs one real vine window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the umber ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x vine window; zero recovery on flag.
